BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to provisional ballots; and adding a new section tochapter 29A.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All provisional ballots and related materials, including the innersecurity envelope and the outer return envelope, must be printed oncolored paper distinctive from regular ballots, absentee ballots, andtheir related materials.
